base.valid_history: NORMAL/is_model_target, finish_count>1, valid rank, finish_time_seconds>0, unambiguous surrogate, prior dirt

opponent.per_observation: prior A0 of other ENTRY runners, >=3 known and >=50%; global prior 365d runner-weighted mean/std, min100; clip z [-3,3]/6
opponent.aggregate: same half-life weighted mean of available deltas

speed.reference: same venue,distance,surface, historical date minus 365 days to exclusive historical date; one winner time per valid race; min100 races, robust median and 1.4826*MAD >0; clip((median-time)/scale,-3,3)/6+.5
speed.aggregate: same half-life weighted mean of available scores

score: if n>=2: F + (0.2*O if n_opp>=2 else 0) + (0.3*(S-F) if n_speed>=2 else 0); if n==1: (p+1.5)/4; if n==0 or ambiguous: NULL
ranking: round(score,12) desc, horse_no asc; store raw finite score
confirmation: LOCKED_2024_2025 until P8B config Freeze; 2026 excluded
